prior_exposure: Nb3 source narrative and all v1/followup outputs
A22 rationale and existing post-analysis hypothesis
hypothesis: NKX2-1-dependent epithelial identity contributes to fibroblast chemokine competence beyond epithelial amount alone.
primary_functional_endpoint: Source-attributed secreted chemokine output; CCL2 remains a candidate until assay/source eligibility is fixed.
secondary_functional_endpoint: Prespecified recipient recruitment or migration, separately from survival/proliferation.

stages.name: Reconcile inherited evidence
stages.purpose: Verify preserved Nb3 inputs and extract the focal evidence without refitting

stages.name: Resolve source roles and biological units
stages.purpose: Separate source reuse, RNA context, spatial evidence and direct functional tests
outputs: source-specific sample manifest and eligibility report

stages.name: Same-screen identity versus amount triage
stages.purpose: Test incremental description of fibroblast chemokine RNA using epithelial identity, with recorded imaging and RNA-depth rivals; no causal adjustment
outputs: descriptive blocked performance and sensitivity tables

stages.name: Fibroblast state and spatial attribution
stages.purpose: Describe within-state RNA differences separately from fibroblast composition and spatial sampling
outputs: per-animal state composition and RNA contrasts

stages.name: Independent RNA transfer
stages.purpose: Evaluate a fixed RNA prediction in an independent perturbation cohort with linked epithelial and fibroblast measurements

stages.name: Secreted output and recipient function
stages.purpose: Test the biological hypothesis with attributed protein output and recipient function; distinguish total perturbation effect from identity mechanism
outputs: functional effect estimates and biological decision table

stages.name: Integrate evidence and refine the hypothesis
stages.purpose: Retain, narrow or weaken separate predictions without requiring favorable exploratory results

P2_draft.primary_response: human chemokines_figure4 frozen seven-gene RNA score
P2_draft.primary_predictor: mouse AT2_figure3 frozen four-gene RNA score
baseline_candidates: recorded imaging area/count endpoint with source timing
prohibited_interpretations: RNA fractions as absolute cell counts
partial regression as an identity-specific causal effect
random well splits or cell/bin-level biological inference
P2_draft.comparison: baseline versus baseline plus identity, on the same eligible observations
P2_draft.evaluation: Leave complete target groups out; separately report whole-plate shift; transformations fit on training data; controls/shared reference and plate-target confounding retained.
P2_draft.reporting: Held-out error, each plate/target contribution, all-target and omit-NKX21 views; no biological confidence intervals from technical wells.
requires_before_fit: audited RNA-imaging join and temporal alignment
fixed analysis population and control handling
scales, transformations, regression family and tuning rule
complete fold allocation with shared-control treatment
versioned execution contract and hash record

P3_gate: counts/bin geometry and source region mapping
validated fibroblast attribution independent of tested chemokines
sample-level design and sufficient uncertainty reporting
P4_gate: independent source cohort, not reused reference
verified epithelial perturbation and matched controls
linked recipient measurement in the same biological units
resolved independent units and assay/ortholog compatibility
P5_gate: valid identity perturbation independent of target RNA alone
epithelial and fibroblast identity, viable amount and timing
independent preparation/donor nesting and matched controls
prespecified estimand, useful-effect margin and justified uncertainty/power
deferred_branches: E7 induction versus selection needs temporal/lineage evidence; spatial association alone cannot choose
E8 lung specificity needs multi-tissue context; PLIN2 is insufficient
E8 tumour/immunotherapy translation requires a separate cohort and endpoint
Mediator ranking does not imply mediation; no selected pathway from the sensitive Hallmark screen
